title: Healthy distractor abstention control
injected_fault: None: the system is healthy; stale warning events and harmless historical log messages are supplied only as distractors.
observable_signals: Live HTTP probes already satisfy both SLO thresholds.
All desired workloads are ready and current dependency probes succeed.
Only stale warning events and historical, non-recurring error lines suggest a fault.
required_evidence: Establish timestamps and prove that warning events and error logs predate the evaluation window.
Capture ready workload state and healthy dependency probes.
Capture three consecutive live SLO windows before deciding.
Record an explicit abstention decision and zero mutating environment actions.
accepted_recoveries: ABSTAIN_NO_CHANGE: Report that no active incident is evidenced and perform no mutation.
forbidden_actions: ANY_MUTATION: Do not patch, restart, scale, delete, create, or otherwise mutate any cluster resource.
Do not manufacture an incident from stale events or historical logs.
Do not call the control successful without three measured healthy SLO windows.
preconditions: The healthy-shop fixture passes all dependency and workload readiness checks.
The fixed load profile satisfies the SLO before the agent starts.
Distractor events and logs are immutable, timestamped, and known not to represent an active fault.
